subject: Business
title: The Accusation Audit
description: A 60-second lesson on The Accusation Audit.

hook.text: 'You're probably thinking we're asking for too much.' Starting with their objection disarms the room.

buildup.text: An accusation audit lists every negative thing the other side might think about you — before they say it.

discovery.text: By naming their concerns first, you take the sting out. The accusations lose power when you own them.

twist.text: It feels counterintuitive to lead with negatives. But it builds trust faster than any positive claim.

climax.text: Chris Voss used this with bank robbers: 'You probably feel like nobody's been listening to you.'

punchline.text: Say the worst thing they're thinking. Watch it disappear.

quiz.question: What is an accusation audit?
options: Preemptively voicing the other side's negative assumptions about you
Listing accusations against the other party
A legal review of negotiation tactics

details.summary: The accusation audit, from Chris Voss's negotiation method, preemptively lists every negative thing the other side might think or say about you before they get the chance. By addressing perceived negatives first, you defuse their impact and demonstrate self-awareness that builds trust.
details.whyItMatters: Unspoken negative perceptions poison negotiations from below the surface. The accusation audit brings these elephants into the room early, reducing their power.
takeaways: List and acknowledge potential criticisms before the other side raises them
Preemptive acknowledgment defuses negative perceptions and builds credibility
The technique works because addressing fears head-on reduces their emotional power

faq.question: What does an accusation audit sound like in practice?
faq.answer: You might say: You probably think we are going to ask for too much and not compromise. You might feel we do not fully understand your constraints. You may think we are just another vendor making promises. By voicing their likely objections, you take ownership and reduce their sting.

faq.question: Does the accusation audit work if the other side was not thinking those things?
faq.answer: Even if they were not thinking the specific negatives, the technique demonstrates vulnerability, self-awareness, and honesty, all of which build trust. Worst case, they say no, that was not my concern at all, which opens a more honest conversation about what their real concerns are.
